title: docs(spec): two upgrade-guide entries state the record page rules as merged

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XC63go34oEMBFaBgqpoDC8N)_

Fixes #35701
Fixes #36211

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches either entry's text; `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` §4 already says a `kind: 'full'` page is drawn on the desktop full page only, and no skill names the field-group refusal's shapes

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：作者运行升级命令时看到的两条升级说明改成与现行规则一致；界面和检查都不变。
- 为什么做：主从子表与字段分组的规则、以及完整记录页只在桌面完整页按原样显示的规则都已合入，两条已发布的升级说明还写着旧说法。
- 出错会怎样：只改说明文字，不改任何检查、拒绝或数据，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。第三张卡（#35846，检查清单里主从子表那一项）不在本 PR：它已被 #36188 的 PR #36284 取代并关闭，那条清单项在那边按新规则重写。

Seat: `repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kDGa1ViantgrfH797`, area a4-I. Card 35846 was folded into this dispatch and is **left out of this PR on purpose**: see Acceptance notes.

## Read first

1. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.field-group-related-list-side-card-refused.ts`: the riskiest hunk is the `reason` parenthetical and the "Ruling B keeps the FK's declared relatedList authoritative" sentence. Check them against `isGroupPlaceableRelationship` / `fieldGroupBodyTableRefusal` in `packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts`.
2. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-slots-tabs-retired.ts`: the `replacement` tail now reads like `PAGE_SLOTS_TABS_REMEDY` in `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`.
3. `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`: one dated sentence was added to the `fieldGroups[].relatedList` note.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ui/page-slots-tabs-retirement.test.ts src/migrations/migrations.test.ts`. Both files should pass. The D3 pin still finds `` `kind: 'full'` `` and no tracker number in any field shown to authors.

## What changes

- **`field-group-related-list-side-card-refused`** (card 35701). Since the body-table predicate was widened, a field group may place a `master_detail` FK that declares no `relatedList`, with or without `inlineEdit`, and the group makes it a body table. `isGroupPlaceableRelationship` accepts this shape, and so do the `defineStack` and publish-door refusals. The entry still listed it as refused. Changes:
  - `surface`: the shape "a plain master_detail with no inlineEdit" is removed from the refused list.
  - `replacement`: "for an inline-edited master_detail remove an explicit `relatedList: true`" becomes "for a master_detail …".
  - `reason`: the old predicate in the parenthetical is replaced by the merged one. The text matches the refusal sentence: "`relatedList: 'primary'`, or a master_detail FK that declares no relatedList, which the group makes a body table".
  - The entry's header comment is corrected the same way.
  - The `id`, `acceptanceCriteria` and every predicate are unchanged.
- **`page-slots-tabs-retired`** (card 36211). The `replacement` tail and the `acceptanceCriteria` now say a `kind: 'full'` page is drawn as authored on the desktop full record page, and that a phone and the side preview draw the standard record page with the composed strip. This matches the remedy and describe as merged in `92e0475e`. The pin file's docblock line says the same.
- **Stale notes from 35701, comment only:**
  - `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`: the `relatedList` evidence now says "absent on a master_detail FK that a parent field group places".
  - `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`: the `fieldGroups[].relatedList` note gains one dated sentence about the widened placeable set. Verdict unchanged: LIVE.
- **Checklist quote (scope addition 7027500679):** in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, item `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` steps[1] quotes the `relatedList` describe. The quote now matches the describe as it stands on `main`. This is the only edit in that file. No other item and no revision changes: it is a correction to a quote, and what the step asks the grader to do is unchanged.
- Changeset `.changeset/35701-shipped-text-after-body-tables.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor. The kind is `semantic`, and per AGENTS.md step 3 a kind other than `none` takes at least minor. PR `92e0475e` used the same level for its describe-only change.

`os migrate meta` lists the same entries for the same stacks. `relevantWhen` is keyed on top-level stack keys and is untouched, and the edit is in place: no new entry and no superseding entry.

## Tests

<details><summary>Spec unit tests and gates (filled from the local run, see Verification)</summary>

At head `483e6f51f` (all under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT command-exit 0 each):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 869 passed (869), Tests 27877 passed, 1 todo. This includes `src/ui/page-slots-tabs-retirement.test.ts` (the D3 entry pin) and `src/migrations/*.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0; `registry.ts is current (638 semantic, 307 retired-key, 249 retired-def)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` (the os migrate meta guidance pin), after building the cli closure: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 3 passed.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (text only).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Card 35846 not done (its premise was overtaken).** Its Done-when asks the item to cite "the 2026-11-20 ADR-0035 note". That note was PR 35845, which was closed unmerged by maintainer ruling on 2026-11-20 22:08Z: 「35845 和新规则冲突，直接关闭作废」. The ADR on `main` has no such note. Separately, `f3c9d426f` (2026-11-21) made a plain `master_detail` child a tab by default. It is a body table only where a parent field group places it, and it is then drawn at that group's position. The item `records-forms.master-detail-body-tables` assumes the old default throughout: **Resolved 2026-11-22:** the seat closed #35846 as superseded by #36188; PR #36284 rewrites the item to the #35921 rule (no citation of PR 35845).
  - its title says "a table in the record overview by default … never a tab";
  - its fixture is `showcase_task.project`, which no `showcase_project` field group names;
  - clause [2] and the negatives say the list has no tab;
  - its rule cells read "no relatedList → body".

  Writing only the new order would leave the item false, so this PR makes no edit to it. The next step is in the report's `open_questions`.
- **Scope addition, quote target.** The addition asked for the describe "as merged by #35691". `f3c9d426f` has since replaced that describe: its "absent = 'primary' on a master_detail field" no longer holds. The quote therefore uses the describe on `main` at `c30ce97c`. Quoting the older text would have added a false statement.
- **35701's stale-note list, measured at `c30ce97c`:**
  - Already current, no edit made (refreshed by the #35889 / #35921 work): ObjectFieldInspector (`readRelatedListMode` docblock, now at about line 3058) and the ObjectGroupInspector `RelatedTablePlacement` docblock. The `lint data-model-rules` notes at :292 and :1012 already cite the group rule.
  - Skipped by order: RecordDetailView (seat 1 is editing it).
  - Left alone, under `ui/` and outside this claim: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:306` "drawn as authored" (docblock).
- **Not touched, by rule:** `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md` near line 2317 still states the old remedy in a released entry. Package changelogs are release-owned. Correcting a released entry takes its own docs-only PR.
- **Remaining wording drift, out of scope:** `field-group-related-list-side-card-refused` still says "side card in the related column". Since the tab row work, a non-body list is a tab with a rail card. The card asked only for the predicate.

## Verification

Gate families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `483e6f51f`: 92 commands, all run under the lock; `--ran` reconciliation: 92 derived, 92 run, 0 UNRUN.

- 87 exited 0 on the first pass, among them `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:docs` (249 generated files in sync), `check:liveness`, `check:platform-checklist` (16 areas, 436 items OK), `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:adr-0087-registration`.
- 3 answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3 or 1, an unbuilt package) and exited 0 after `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/cli...' build`: `migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:lean-entry-closure`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which needs a full workspace build (105 packages without dist). CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it.
- NOT MEASURED: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, whose positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach. It is checker health only and cannot judge this diff.
- `generated references`: `content/docs/references/**` embeds neither entry (`git grep` finds both ids only in release notes), so nothing was regenerated. The upgrade guide and spec-changes are gitignored projections, checked in memory above.
- Overlap: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean (PRs 36233 and 36223 share `records-forms.json` and merge cleanly).
